title: Corporate Digital Transformation and Environmental Performance: Evidence from the People’s Republic of China
description: This paper examines how digital transformation influences corporate environmental performance.

title: Sustainability-Adjusted Credit Guarantee Pricing for Financing Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Enterprises in Malaysia
description: This paper outlines a risk-based and sustainability-adjusted credit guarantee pricing framework for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Malaysia. The framework considers a firm’s financial health, environmental footprint, and macroeconomic conditions.

title: The Great Reallocation Revisited: How Foreign Direct Investment Is (and Is Not) Shifting amid Heightened Geopolitical Tensions
description: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment flows are evolving amid geoeconomic fragmentation.

title: Skills That Pay: Digital Skills Demand and Wage Premia in Asia and the Pacific
description: Using a large language model to analyze millions of job postings, this paper tracks requirements for digital and artificial intelligence skills across six economies during 2019–2024.

title: Zombies, Insolvency Reform, and Misallocation of Capital
description: This study shows that insolvency reforms in economies with a high prevalence of distressed and zombie firms lead to more efficient allocation of capital.

title: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment
description: Special economic zones (SEZs) in Viet Nam significantly shaped firm growth and local governance from 2006–2020.

title: Financing Nature: Investment Funds and Biodiversity Risks
description: This paper examines investment fund responses to biodiversity risk.

title: Digital Connectivity and Household Income: Evidence from Women-Headed Households in Viet Nam
description: This paper analyzes the impact of digital connectivity on the incomes of households headed by women in Viet Nam. It provides insights into the inclusive effects of digital connectivity and policy recommendations for advancing digital infrastructure development.

title: Automating Evidence Synthesis: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Language Models for Data Extraction
description: This paper evaluates an automated pipeline for extracting structured metadata from full-text scientific articles to accelerate systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

title: Trade De-Specialization: Dynamics and Determinants
description: Why do economies lose their export edge—and what drives it? This paper examines trade de-specialization, the often-overlooked flip side of economic development and structural transformation.

title: Predictors of Climate Change Concern and Climate Policy Support: An Analysis Across Asian Economies
description: Drawing on a survey of 13,547 respondents across 14 Asian economies, this paper examines public perceptions of climate change and support for key climate policies.

title: Asia’s Structural Transformation: Patterns, Challenges, and New Stylized Facts
description: This paper explores structural transformation, premature deindustrialization, and industrial policy in Asia, highlighting the importance of context-specific policies.

title: Structural Transformation and Productivity in Asia: An Overview
description: This paper analyzes structural transformation across Asian economies and its implications for growth.

title: When Manufacturing Matters Most: Structural Transformation and Productivity Growth Trajectories in Developing and Emerging Economies
description: The findings of this study suggest that low-income economies could boost productivity through strategies that combine manufacturing development with investments in institutional quality, technological infrastructure, and human capital formation.

title: Work from Home and Fertility
description: This study examines how realized and planned fertility are associated with work from home (WFH) arrangements.

title: Impact of the 2025 United States Tariffs on Firm Export Behavior: Evidence from Asian Customs Data
description: This paper dissects the impact of United States (US) tariffs introduced in 2025 on firm exports by using comprehensive export customs data to the US from six selected Asian countries, concentrating on heterogeneity by firm size and product type for analyses.

title: Private Sector Development and Policy Actions in Timor-Leste: Lessons from a Business Mapping Survey
description: This paper empirically investigates what drives the growth of private businesses in Timor-Leste and the policy actions needed to facilitate growth amid global uncertainty, especially for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs).

title: Workers’ Exposure to Artificial Intelligence Across Development Stages
description: This paper finds that workers in low-income countries face lower exposure to artificial intelligence than those in high-income countries, mainly due to within-occupation task differences, and discusses the implications.

title: Heat Stress, Air Pollution Risk and Population Exposure: Evidence from Selected Asian Countries
description: This paper examines heat stress and air pollution in Bangladesh, Indonesia, Pakistan, Thailand, and Viet Nam, looking at patterns of exposure among different population groups and discussing policy implications.

title: Climate Shocks and Noncommunicable Diseases Among Older People in India
description: This paper shares findings from a study of the impact of temperature and rainfall on the incidence of noncommunicable diseases among older people in India.
